name: SDSS J1652+1728

images.note: Among the most luminous ERQ hosts (z=2.942); candidate tidal tail; later a JWST ERS target (Zakamska et al. 2019).

paper.title: Host galaxies of high-redshift extremely red and obscured quasars

images.credit: Vayner et al. 2023, [O III] 5007 maps figure (crop)
images.note: Line-integrated [O III] flux map of the ERQ J1652: ionized nebula across ~30 kpc incl. outflow, companions, tidal-tail gas. Obs 2022-07-15/16 (ERS Q3D). First-results companion paper Wylezalek 2022 (2210.10074) uses an ESA/Webb composite (not croppable per press-image rule).

paper.title: First Results from the JWST Early Release Science Program Q3D: Ionization Cone, Clumpy Star Formation, and Shocks in a z = 3 Extremely Red Quasar Host

notes: One of the most luminous extremely red quasars (ERQ, z=2.942); HST/WFC3 F160W PSF-subtracted imaging shows a candidate tidal tail (Zakamska et al. 2019); later a JWST ERS target.
